**Performance Marketing World Names Taboola a Finalist for the 2026 PMW Awards Under ‘Martech Innovation’ Category**


**New York, NY** – Taboola (Nasdaq: TBLA), a global leader in delivering performance at scale for advertisers, today announced that it has been named a finalist in the ‘Martech Innovation’ category at the 2026 Performance Marketing World (PMW) Awards. The recognition is based on the success of Taboola’s performance advertising platform,[Realize](https://realize.com/) **.**


**What:** The Performance Marketing World Awards celebrate excellence in performance marketing, recognizing the technologies, strategies and teams driving innovation and measurable business results. They are one of the advertising and technology industry’s definitive celebrations of the analytical minds, the ROI-obsessed teams, and the cutting-edge tech turning clicks into commercial growth.


The ‘Martech Innovation’ accolade was given to Taboola’s performance advertising platform, Realize. Realize is a technology platform that helps advertisers achieve outcomes at scale, leveraging Taboola’s unique supply, first-party data, and AI. It enables performance campaigns across many of the world’s largest and most trusted publishers, OEMs, and apps.


**When:** The 2026 PMW Awards ceremony took place on Thursday, November 5, at the Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London.


**Where:** The finalist listing can be found on PMW’s Awards website[here](https://www.performancemarketingworldawards.com/finalists/realize-the-open-web-re-engineered-for-performance-ss9o3ef34981wcb) .
